traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria in 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are fully implemented and verified:
- Core validation of `@story` and `@req` syntax and format (including `@supports`) is implemented by `valid-annotation-format` with helpers in `valid-annotation-format-validators.ts`, `valid-annotation-options.ts`, and `valid-annotation-format-internal.ts`. These enforce the documented default patterns (story paths under `docs/stories/*.story.md` and `REQ-*` identifiers) and support multi-line annotations and varied comment styles. - Tests in `tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts` are explicitly tagged for this story and cover all listed requirements: format specification, syntax validation, path format, requirement format, multiline support, flexible parsing, and detailed, specific error messages. The Jest run (`npm test -- --verbose`) shows this suite passing in full. - Error messages are centralized via `meta.messages.invalidStoryFormat` / `invalidReqFormat` / `invalidImplementsFormat` and constructed with helpers that include specific details and examples, matching the story’s examples and REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY. - Edge cases and malformed comments (missing values, malformed multi-line values, invalid regex configuration) are handled gracefully: configuration errors are surfaced via `invalidRuleConfiguration` while continuing validation with defaults, and multi-line parsing uses normalization plus pending state finalization. - Documentation in `docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md` provides a clear, detailed format specification and examples of valid/invalid annotations consistent with the story text.
Given the concrete implementation, comprehensive targeted tests, and passing test suite, this story is fully satisfied.
